tasks.title: Ad-hoc capture + simplification

roadmap add --spec ... still REFUSES an empty/absent --ac (a confirmed-spec story needs acceptance criteria).
WORKFLOW.md Source-of-Truth mirrors stories only; no 'task state is mirrored into the tracker' language remains.
docs/degraded-mode.md documents manual forge pr-link as a fallback for when pr-link.yml cannot run, noting Gate B automates it normally.
verify_commands: uv run --with pytest python -m pytest factory/tests/test_gates.py -q -k "no_spec or adhoc or roadmap_add"
tasks.reviewer_focus: --ac required only with --spec, optional with --no-spec (accepted if given); the 0014 spec-debt gate untouched; WORKFLOW mirror is stories-only; pr-link command/automation/tests all preserved (docs-only demotion); refactor delta stays lean.
